project.name: CHB
project.description: Personal, offline-first dashboard for work, finances, goals, health and cross-module statistics.
principles: Cloud synchronization must not silently overwrite conflicts
Daily WorkDay records are the source of truth for work data
Tables are the primary daily work interface
Preferences use the centralized app settings layer
Generated Markdown is output; docs/data JSON is the source of truth
The application must remain usable on older hardware

context.currentGoal: Expand the Global Panel System across the most space-intensive Work panels and compact the week controls into the page header.
nextTasks: Verify all four Work panels remember their open state
Verify week controls align below the week badge
Review Work page height at laptop and Full HD widths
Choose the next pages for panel migration

knownIssues.description: Experimental beer comparison may present confusing values and requires a later quality pass.
Historical screenshots contain daily duration but not exact session start and end times. Imported duration-placeholder sessions must be excluded from future hour-of-day analysis.

constraints: Preserve Supabase snapshot and backup compatibility
Do not remove backward-compatible fields without a migration
Keep the application responsive on an older laptop
Do not make generated Markdown the source of truth

modules.name: Application Shell
modules.description: Routing, layout, navigation, theme and global providers.
aiNotes: Preserve HashRouter compatibility for GitHub Pages.

modules.name: Dashboard
modules.description: Central daily interface and weekly overview.
aiNotes: Dashboard edits the same WorkDay records as the Work module.

modules.name: Work
modules.description: Work weeks, daily records, earnings, goals, tables and experimental intelligence.
aiNotes: WorkDay is the source of truth for daily work values.

modules.name: Settings
aiNotes: Components must use appSettingsService/useAppSettings instead of direct Dexie reads for preferences.

modules.name: Cloud Sync
modules.description: Private Supabase snapshot synchronization and conflict protection.
aiNotes: Never silently overwrite a detected two-sided conflict.

modules.name: Local Database
modules.description: Dexie/IndexedDB schema, migrations and local-first persistence.
aiNotes: Schema changes require explicit migrations and backup compatibility review.

modules.name: Portfolio
modules.description: Income and expense ledger, balances, tags, statistics and CSV import.
aiNotes: Portfolio balance is derived from the initial balance and chronologically ordered transactions.
Transactions store positive amounts; type determines the signed ledger value.

modules.name: Alcohol
modules.description: Cross-module alcohol analytics derived from Work beer counts and Portfolio expenses.
aiNotes: Alcohol is an analytical module, not the owner of beer counts or Portfolio transactions.
Work owns daily beer counts; Portfolio owns financial transactions.
Alcohol may store only manual day overrides, historical monthly costs and linkage settings.

issues.title: Experimental beer comparison can be confusing
issues.description: The experimental comparison may present values that are easy to interpret as day counts or strong conclusions when the sample is small.
issues.workaround: Treat CHB Intelligence as experimental and verify the sample-size labels.
issues.plannedResolution: Dedicated CHB Intelligence quality pass with clearer units, minimum sample sizes and confidence indicators.

issues.title: Production main chunk exceeds the Vite warning threshold
issues.description: The production bundle currently emits a chunk-size warning after minification.
issues.workaround: The warning does not block deployment.
issues.plannedResolution: Add route-level lazy loading and production code splitting during a later quality pass.

issues.title: Historical sessions do not contain exact source clock times
issues.description: The source screenshots contain daily duration but not exact session start and end times.
issues.workaround: Use duration-placeholder session IDs and exclude those sessions from future hour-of-day analysis.
issues.plannedResolution: Keep the imported duration for totals. Exact clock-time analysis will use only native CHB sessions unless original timestamps are provided later.

issues.title: Legacy cloud snapshot lacks Portfolio arrays
issues.description: Snapshots created before v0.6.0 do not contain portfolioAccounts, portfolioTags or portfolioTransactions.
issues.workaround: Install v0.6.0a and preserve the local version when resolving the first post-upgrade comparison.

issues.title: Portfolio CSV import result was discarded by the hook
issues.description: The generic action wrapper returned Promise<void>, while the CSV panel required the import summary.

acceptedDecisions.title: Use a local-first data model
acceptedDecisions.context: CHB must remain usable without internet and on multiple devices.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Dexie is the primary local store; Supabase synchronizes snapshots without replacing local-first behavior.
consequences: UI updates do not wait for the network
Conflicts require safe comparison and explicit resolution
Cloud synchronization is debounced for older hardware

acceptedDecisions.title: Use WorkDay as the source of truth for daily work data
acceptedDecisions.context: Dashboard, Work and future statistics must calculate from identical records.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Paid messages, held messages, beers, rating and sessions are stored on WorkDay.
consequences: Weekly totals are derived from days
Dashboard edits the same records as the Work page
Legacy weekly heldMessages remains temporarily for compatibility

acceptedDecisions.title: Use tables as the primary daily work interface
acceptedDecisions.context: The user works faster in spreadsheet-like interfaces than in detached forms.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Daily work values are edited inline with keyboard navigation; forms are reserved for complex configuration.
consequences: Enter saves values
Table density is configurable
Future data-heavy modules should reuse the table system

acceptedDecisions.title: Centralize application preferences
acceptedDecisions.context: Preferences will expand to colors, tab order, layouts and future modules.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Components use appSettingsService and useAppSettings rather than reading Dexie directly.
consequences: Preferences are synchronized and backed up automatically
UI reacts to preference changes
Future settings share one architecture

acceptedDecisions.title: Use machine-readable project data as documentation source
acceptedDecisions.context: The roadmap and changelog are too large to maintain reliably by hand.
acceptedDecisions.decision: docs/data JSON is authoritative; Markdown and AI context files are generated outputs.
consequences: Documentation can be validated
Multiple AI providers can consume the same project interface
Manual edits to generated files are overwritten

acceptedDecisions.title: Keep the AI Project Interface vendor-neutral
acceptedDecisions.context: The project may later use Cursor, OpenAI, Anthropic, Copilot, Gemini, MCP or local models.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Use plain JSON, JSON Schema and generated Markdown without provider-specific requirements in the core.
consequences: Provider adapters can be added later
Project context remains portable
Core project data does not require an AI SDK

acceptedDecisions.title: Generate provider adapters from one AI Project Interface
acceptedDecisions.context: Different coding agents use different conventional context files.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Keep canonical context in docs/data and generate AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules as disposable adapters.
consequences: Provider files never become independent sources of truth
A new provider can be added without changing project data
Generated adapters are checked for drift in CI and release preparation

acceptedDecisions.title: Analytical modules do not duplicate domain data
acceptedDecisions.context: The Alcohol module needs Work beer data and Portfolio expenses while preserving historical corrections.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Domain modules own their data. Analytical modules read source data and store only their own settings, corrections and metadata. Before implementing a feature, determine the data owner, verify whether existing data can be reused, and classify the module as a data owner or an analytical consumer.
consequences: Every new feature identifies one owning module for each stored value.
Existing source data is reused instead of copied into parallel storage.
Analytical modules store only settings, corrections and metadata.
Backup, restore and cloud synchronization serialize the complete connected ecosystem.

acceptedDecisions.title: Work time analytics are derived from session blocks
acceptedDecisions.context: Standard, additional and weekend time plus weekday ratings are needed without creating parallel stored totals.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Split absolute session intervals at time-of-day, midnight and weekend boundaries. Calculate all category totals, daily scores and weekly averages dynamically from Work sessions.
consequences: Cross-midnight sessions are assigned according to the real calendar minute.
No derived rating or duration totals are persisted.
Future monthly and yearly analysis can reuse the same engine.

acceptedDecisions.title: Panel expansion state is local UI state
acceptedDecisions.context: Collapsible panels need to remember the user's local layout without adding domain data or forcing the same open panels on every device.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Store panel open and closed state in localStorage. Do not include it in Dexie, backup or Supabase during the pilot.
consequences: Panel state survives browser reloads on one device.
Panel layout can differ between desktop and mobile devices.
No database migration or cloud snapshot change is required.
